spans.text: Perimeter of the restricted area, White Zone.
Tokarev and Kalina crouch behind a stretch of rubble, carefully observing the cordoned-off site ahead.
The entire area is sealed tight with temporary fencing and warning tape. A fully armed soldier stands guard every 30 meters.
Several military vehicles are parked along the perimeter. Soldiers gather in small groups, chatting occasionally, but none of them venture deeper into the site itself.
The security deployment is surprisingly lax. They seem focused solely on keeping civilians out, and show little concern for what's inside.
That's rather strange... By all rights, an incident of this magnitude should have professional investigators swarming the scene.
Maybe... they've already finished investigating?
Or perhaps... they never intended to investigate at all?
Tokarev's electronic eyes sweep rapidly across the restricted zone, mapping the guard positions and patrol routes.
There's a section of fencing on the west side near a construction site. The view is blocked by building materials.
There are two soldiers on the east side, but they rotate off their posts every 15 minutes.
We can use that gap to slip in.
Kalina nods, but Tokarev notices her pallor and trembling hands.
Miss Kalina, your condition...
I'm fine.
We don't have much time.
This is a battlefield, Miss Kalina.
Please follow my instructions. Keep your steps light and stay low.
If there's danger, get down immediately.
After successfully slipping past the guards, Tokarev and Kalina finally reach the heart of the explosion site.
The sight before them leaves them stunned.
The area is nothing but ruins.

Buildings that once gleamed in the White Zone are now reduced to twisted rubble and debris. The ground is torn open by a massive crater. Surrounding structures have either collapsed or been scorched black by fire.

At the center of the blast zone lies the grotesquely twisted wreckage of a military tank. The turret has been blown clear off, and the armor plating ripped apart. Black scorch marks spread outward from within.
This... this couldn't have been caused by an ordinary explosion...
The scale is far too large...
It could have been an ammunition detonation.
But even then, the level of destruction exceeds standard parameters.
Kalina takes a deep breath to herself.
Tokarev notices her unsteady steps as she clenches her teeth and forces herself toward the wrecked tank.
Let's split up.
I'll check the surrounding area. You examine the inside of the tank.
Contact me immediately if you find anything.
Miss Kalina, the site could still be dangerous...
Kalina shakes her head, her gaze firm.
There's no time.
Don't worry about me. I know how to protect myself.
Tokarev hesitates, then finally nods.
Tokarev approaches the tank wreckage cautiously while analyzing the structural damage.
The armor has been torn apart by an immense force from the inside, but the signs suggest that it was more than a simple explosion.
Some fractures show clear signs of being cut by high-energy weapons, as if two different forms of destruction are layered together.
She climbs into the tank's interior. The cramped space is completely devastated.
Near the driver's seat, she spots several gleaming fragments—Doll structural components.
Tokarev picks one up and examines it closely. The fine circuitry and specialized alloys could only have belonged to a high-end Tactical Doll.
So these are the remains of "Dandelion" mentioned in the news? ...But Miss Kalina said Dandelion's body was special.
These parts here... are sophisticated, yes, but there's nothing unusual about them...
What troubles Tokarev more is that the fragments are simply left behind.
Under standard military protocol, any Doll remains should have been fully recovered, especially evidence tied to a so-called "terrorist attack".
...It's almost as if they were deliberately left here to be found.
She continues searching and soon discovers large amounts of dried blood on the tank's inner walls and seats.
The splatter patterns indicate a blood loss of at least two liters—fatal without immediate medical intervention.
Yet once again, something is off. There are no traces of human tissue.
Why wasn't the scene properly cleaned? Why leave blood and Doll fragments, but remove all biological remains?
Questions pile up in Tokarev's neural cloud, but she finds no answer to any of them.
She records everything carefully and prepares to leave the tank to report to Kalina—
When her communicator crackles with Kalina's faint voice.
Tokarev... come here... quickly...
Tokarev climbs out of the tank and follows the signal.
She finds Kalina standing motionless near a pile of rubble about 50 meters away.
Her body trembles as she stares at the collapsed wall before her.
Miss Kalina? Did you find something?
Kalina doesn't answer. She simply raises a shaking hand and points at the wall.
Tokarev looks in the direction—hanging from the blackened wall is a torn jacket.
A Griffin uniform jacket. Its cuffs and collar are shredded, the fabric soaked with blood and dust. Even in this condition, Tokarev recognizes it immediately.
The Commander's jacket.
Kalina's breathing grows ragged. She staggers forward, reaching out with trembling fingers to touch the jacket.
She carefully takes the jacket down and cradles it in her arms. The front is nearly saturated with dried blood, dark brown with oxidation.
The sleeves are scorched, and one side has been ripped open by something sharp.
This... this is the Commander's...
Miss Kalina, this alone doesn't—
Kalina suddenly collapses to her knees, clutching the jacket tightly as her body shakes violently.
Silent tears stream down her face. A broken sob escapes her throat.
No... no... Commander...
You promised... you promised you'd come back...
Tokarev crouches beside her, wanting to comfort her, but words fail her.
Any attempt at consolation from a Doll would feel hollow.
All she can do is stay close, watching as the strong, cheerful girl finally breaks under the weight of despair.
We went through so much together... so much... Why... why did it have to be this time...
You promised... you'd never play such stupid pranks on me again...
Why... why leave this behind...
Are they trying to tell me that the Commander really...
Her voice fades, and her eyes lose focus.
Tokarev immediately senses something wrong and catches Kalina as her body slumps forward.
Miss Kalina!
Kalina's eyelids flutter shut. Her lips tremble as if she wants to speak, but no words come.
Her body goes limp as her consciousness slips away, her fingers still clenched tightly around the blood-stained jacket.
Tokarev quickly checks her vitals—her pulse is weak but stable, her breathing is rapid, and her face looks deathly pale.
Preliminary diagnosis—severe exhaustion combined with psychological shock, resulting in temporary collapse.
Carefully, Tokarev lifts Kalina into her arms and looks once more over the devastated ruins.
In the distance, soldiers outside the restricted zone seem to have noticed something and begin moving in their direction.
...Hang in there, Miss Kalina.
I'm getting you out of here...
Kalina is still gripping the uniform jacket.
Carrying her unconscious companion, Tokarev slips silently into the shadows of the ruins, disappearing from sight.
